title: Robot Generalization Beyond Volume: The Diversity Path via Zero-Shot Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.29829v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose robots must handle tasks, objects and environments they were never trained on, yet zero-shot generalization remains one of the least solved problems in physical AI. In digital AI, zero-shot capability grew with the volume and, above all, the diversity of training data, much of it sourced from the crowd. Robotics instead relies on paid collection by a few well-funded teams, which yields volume without diversity. We formulate zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, and show that more samples from the same collectors shrink the unseen region only slowly, while each new contributor can extend it. Building on this and on zero-shot learning, we propose a shared latent space for robot actions that combines multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning. translated_title: 超越数据规模的机器人泛化：通过零样本能力实现的多样性路径
translated_abstract: 通用机器人必须能够处理它们从未被训练过的任务、物体和环境，然而零样本泛化仍然是物理AI中悬而未决的核心难题之一。在数字AI领域，零样本能力随着训练数据的规模、尤其是多样性的增长而提升，其中大量数据来源于大众群体。相比之下，机器人领域依赖于少数资金雄厚的团队进行付费数据收集，这种模式虽然带来了数据规模，却缺乏多样性。我们将物理AI中的零样本泛化形式化为对部署分布的覆盖，并证明来自同一收集者的更多样本只能缓慢地缩小未见区域，而每一个新的数据贡献者都能扩展这一覆盖范围。基于这一认识以及零样本学习理论，我们提出了一个用于机器人动作的共享潜在空间，它结合了多模态对齐、生成式增强和噪声标签学习。作为可扩展的多样化数据来源，我们提出了一个开发者社区，在一个共享的
tldr: 该论文将物理AI中的零样本泛化形式化为对部署分布的覆盖问题，指出数据多样性比数据规模更关键，并提出了结合多模态对齐、生成式增强和噪声标签学习的机器人动作共享潜在空间，以及通过开发者社区获取多样化数据作为可扩展的解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, showing that data diversity matters more than volume, and proposes a shared latent space for robot actions combining multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning, with a developer community as a scalable source of diverse data.
